final_codebook.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Common denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an LCD or other common denominator is found for fractions with unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractional parts are converted to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag in mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts are converted to a shared denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-denominator conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting whole numbers, proper fractions, or improper mixed-number parts without changing denominators.
Do not tag reducing or simplifying the answer after subtraction.

skills.name: Mixed-form representation
skills.definition: Rewrite or assemble quantities between whole-number, fraction, and mixed-number forms so that operands or results have usable whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper fractional part in a mixed number is normalized into the whole-number part.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a zero fractional part, such as 3 as 3 0/5.
Tag when a proper fraction is treated as a mixed number with zero whole part, such as 1/8 as 0 1/8.
Tag when already-subtracted whole and fractional components are assembled into a mixed number, proper fraction, or integer, including omission of a zero whole or zero fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting to a common denominator.
Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction of numerators or whole-number parts.
Do not tag borrowing one whole to repair a negative fractional subtraction.
Do not tag reducing a nonzero fraction or explicitly simplifying a zero fraction; those are post-subtraction simplification.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract corresponding whole-number parts and like-denominator fractional parts once the operands are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over an unchanged common denominator.
Tag when whole-number parts of mixed numbers or whole-number operands are subtracted.
Tag when a preliminary negative fractional difference is computed before any borrowing is applied.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are subtracted in the same solution step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding or applying a common denominator before subtraction.
Do not tag rewriting operands into mixed-number or whole-plus-fraction form.
Do not tag borrowing to correct a negative fractional part.
Do not tag reducing, zero-simplifying, or final formatting after the subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve post-subtraction issues by borrowing one whole into fractional form when needed and simplifying resulting fractions or zero fractions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a negative fractional part is corrected by borrowing one whole and converting it to d/d.
Tag when the fractional subtraction is recomputed after borrowing.
Tag when a resulting fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction such as 0/d is simplified to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the initial subtraction that produces a negative fractional part.
Do not tag operand normalization that occurs before subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.
Do not tag merely combining an already valid whole part and fractional part with no borrowing, reduction, or zero-fraction simplification.

decisions.details: Refined C01 into S01 Common denominators and S02 Mixed-form representation.
decisions.reasoning: C01 had full consensus as operand setup, but it bundled two independently testable operations: denominator conversion, seen in items such as FS01, and mixed/whole/fraction representation, seen in items such as FS07. Separating them improves Q-matrix identifiability while preserving the shared expert intent.

decisions.details: Kept C02 as S03 Subtract aligned parts.
decisions.reasoning: All three experts identified aligned component subtraction as central. The final skill covers both numerator subtraction over a shared denominator and whole-part subtraction, with clear exclusions for setup, regrouping, and simplification.

decisions.details: Refined C03 as S04 Regroup and simplify.
decisions.reasoning: C03 had full consensus as post-subtraction resolution. The final definition keeps borrowing and simplification together to satisfy the four-skill constraint, while excluding routine final assembly to avoid overlap with S02.

decisions.details: Merged final answer assembly from the aligned setup and simplification candidates into S02 when it is only representational formatting.
decisions.reasoning: Combining already valid whole and fractional components is best treated as mixed-form representation, whereas reducing fractions and simplifying zero fractions remain in S04. This boundary supports consistent tagging.

summary: The final codebook contains four distinct skills: common-denominator conversion, mixed-form representation, aligned subtraction, and post-subtraction regrouping/simplification. The main consolidation decision was to split the broad operand setup candidate into denominator conversion and mixed-form representation because the dossiers show these operations can occur independently. The subtraction candidate was retained, and the post-subtraction resolution candidate was refined to distinguish borrowing and simplification from routine final assembly.
